purpose: Correctness-only proof that four ranks hold identical full BF16 table weights and RMSProp exp_avg_sq moments after 50 optimizer steps. Predicted BPB delta is zero by design; no quality or throughput conclusion follows.

immutable_source.science_diff: Only a new diagnostic header/imports, bounded raw BF16 read-only scanner, atomic per-rank manifest writer and one call after synchronize(device) at step==49 and args.num_steps==50. No model, gradient, optimizer, schedule, loader, checkpoint or evaluator arithmetic changes.
immutable_source.observer_default_off: For all runs not capped at exactly --num-steps 50, the hook is unreachable. The scored c5c source is unchanged. This diagnostic copy must never be used as a scored source or submitted.

memory_and_disk.gate_formula: For each profile, independently review a conservative exact-m64 native compile/cache/checkpoint/log/HBM projection with a separate reserve above the unchanged 6.5-GiB floor; root free must exceed max(10 GiB, reviewed profile-specific threshold) immediately before launch. A null projection or HBM headroom is HOLD, never a reason to lower the gate.

mandatory_gate_sequence: Independent Verifier reviews diagnostic source diff and proves it observational/default-off, exact source/prepare/queue hashes, both JSON proposals and local tests; this Implementer cannot verify itself.

A different Verifier performs exact A1 and A2 four-rank CPU lockstep against unmodified c5c at seed42 with identical synthetic inputs and fake clock: steps 0/1 loss, complete parameter digests, table gradients/updates, RMSProp moments/counters and AdamW/Muon ownership plans identical. Tiny local RMSProp lockstep is not this proof.
Each host's exact full-size c5c m64/d128 four-rank two-step G2 RMS trace independently PASSes its table keys, equal ranks, finite update math, untouched rows and strict checkpoint load.

Each host's separately reviewed 30-step unmodified c5c native table smoke independently PASSes exact source/flags, 0..29 boundaries, finite four-rank evidence, strict model-only load, synthetic causality/batch-independence, disk/HBM safety and quiescence.

A separate Verifier reviews the diagnostic stage, clean pinned source and unchanged prepare.py, source hash, unique label/path absence, all exact env -i assignments and argv, six historical warm-cache device/inode identities, private existing STEP_LOG parent and absent step file, contained launcher, live external boundary observer, disk monitor/interlock and profile-specific HBM/root projection.

A Supervisor grants separate one-attempt native-50 authority only after a final immutable request SHA, independent review and fresh Operator hostname/idle/Neuron/lock/disk/source/cache/checkpoint preflight; one job per host and no open breaker.
On native, steps 0/1 must match same-host unmodified c5c smoke; the boundary observer witnesses 0..49 exactly once and all four workers exit/quiesce. A mismatch is HOLD for diagnosis.

Operator retrieves four fsynced rank manifests, raw logs, boundary/guard/monitor/postflight receipts and model-only checkpoint with hashes; an independent Verifier compares full raw BF16 table and exp_avg_sq SHA-256 per key across four ranks, state step50, finite/nonzero counts, expected shapes/dtypes and RMSProp exclusion from owned plan.

Strict load_for_eval of the diagnostic checkpoint and deterministic synthetic causal/batch-independent checks must pass in a fresh process; no public/private validation evaluation. A failure consumes the label and is recorded, not retried in place.
forbidden_actions: No native launch, host staging, G2, AWS action, cleanup, breaker reset, fresh validation eval, decide.py update, adoption, scored BPB claim or leaderboard submission under this Implementer package.
Never edit scored c5c train.py, root train.py, prepare.py, evaluator, tokenizer, data or scoring; never use the diagnostic source as a scored or submission candidate.

A1 and A2 require separate host-specific evidence and unique one-shot labels. Neither table profile proves the other; no table score can be judged without a separately valid same-host c5c A0 public20M control.
